captions.detailed: A countertop kitchen blender consisting of a matte black base, a semi-transparent textured pitcher with a black handle, a black lid, and an internal spinning blade. The base features a horizontal slider on the front face for speed control. The lid is connected to the back of the pitcher via a hinge, allowing it to swing open, while the slider translates horizontally within its slot, and the blade assembly spins continuously at the bottom of the pitcher.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated kitchen blender with a broad black base, a transparent pitcher, and a black lid. The blender should feature three moving parts: a lid that rotates on a rear hinge, a speed selection slider on the front of the base that translates horizontally, and a blade assembly inside the pitcher that spins continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the base as a rounded box with a recessed slot on the front face. Model the slider as a small box that fits inside the slot and translate it along the X-axis. Create the pitcher body by lofting or extruding a tapered hollow square shape, adding a solid block handle on one side. Model the lid with a flat top and a small cylindrical cap, hinged at the rear. Finally, construct the blade assembly from intersecting thin boxes and place it at the bottom of the pitcher, configured with a continuous rotational joint.
